exploratory_failure.observation: An early owned QEMU pilot timed out after a test wrote SLEEPDEEP, assumed it was retained, then entered ordinary WFI with no remaining wake source. Primary QEMU source inspection showed RAZ/WI. Corrected harness explicitly tests this limitation and uses SLEEPONEXIT for admission refusal.
exploratory_failure.evidence_limit: Observed in tool-session output before campaign tooling; no reconstructed old binary hash or fabricated retained execution log.
